messages:
Ivy: Quick PSA  someone labeled a Tupperware 'team lunch' but no time. Could we add a 'reserved until' field on labels?
Sam: Yes please. I grabbed it thinking it was free and felt bad. Will return if it's reserved.
Rina: Simple idea: sticky label format 'NAME | until HH:MM | event' so it's clear. I'll print a few sheets.
Ivy: Love that. Also can we add a tiny clock sticker set so people can circle the return time? Visual = less guessing.
tool-bot: Supplies queued: adhesive clock stickers x50, sticky label sheets x3. ETA 2 business days. (/order-5512)
Sam: Also micro-policy: if 'team' is on it, assume communal after 30 minutes unless a time is written. Sound fair?
Rina: Agreed. I'll add '30m rule' to the label template.
Ivy: Finally, coffee rota reminder: week of Apr 5 is Sam's week to restock beans. Sam: you in?
Sam: On it. I'll top up beans and oat milk Friday morning.
Ivy: Thank you! Tiny victory: printed labels + clock stickers should cut mystery snack incidents in half. :tada:
